messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Heads-up: New partner "NimbusML" ready to start marketplace activation. Primary items: entitlement mapping, trial SKU gating, deployment region options. Can we do a quick sync?
Ravi (CloudOps): Sure. Do we have their manifest and network requirements? Need bucket ARNs and webhook endpoints.
Asha (Partnerships): Uploaded manifest to the shared drive. They require read access to artifacts only, and a metrics webhook that posts to /hooks/nimbus. No cross-account writes.
Nora (Legal): Check: will their telemetry include IPs or user identifiers? If yes, we need a dataflow and explicit retention period.
Liam (Product): They want 7-day trial SKU with concurrent-seat caps plus a pay-as-you-go core SKU. Also request three pricing bands (starter, team, scale).
Eun (Engineering): For entitlement mapping we can map `nimbus.trial_ends` and `nimbus.max_seats`. Suggest token-exchange sample for them.
Ravi (CloudOps): Proposed IAM role: `redwood-pub-nimbus-readonly` with s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket scoped to their artifacts bucket. Will provision in eu-west-1 by default.
Asha (Partnerships): @Nora they said telemetry is hashed session ids and app_version only. Nora, is that OK?
Nora (Legal): Hashes OK. Need written confirmation that they don't send emails or IPs, and retention <=45 days. Also send the publisher addendum for signature.
listing-bot: Automated manifest lint: missing field `screenshots` and `privacy_summary` in manifest.json. See https://redwood.infra/listing-checks/1755554322
Eun (Engineering): I'll run the validator once screenshots are added. Also can we include a staging integration test for token exchange? cURL snippet to share:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.dev/exchange -d '{"publisher_token":"<TOKEN>"}'
```
Liam (Product): We'll expose `nimbus-core` (metered), `nimbus-trial-7d` (free trial), and optional `nimbus-seat-add-on`. Need final copy for marketplace listing.
Ravi (CloudOps): Note on residency: default is eu-west-1. If customer requests US, that'll be a separate onboarding flow.
Asha (Partnerships): Plan: 1) Ask Nimbus for screenshots + privacy blurb + retention confirm 2) CloudOps provisions IAM + staging sandbox 3) Eng runs validator and integration tests 4) Legal gets signed addendum 5) Product finalizes SKU copy and pricing. Target: soft-publish to staging in 6 business days.
Eun (Engineering): I'll validate manifest and post results here.
Nora (Legal): I'll prepare the addendum and wait for confirmation.
Liam (Product): I'll draft the listing copy and placeholders for screenshots.
Asha (Partnerships): Thanks all. Posting checklist in the shared folder. :rocket:
